title.narrative: Construction of the Bouake - Darakokaha Highway project (54.5 KM)

description.narrative:
The development goals will contribute to economic growth by building sustainable infrastructure that supports international, regional and national connectivity, in line with the PND 2021-2025 to achieve economic growth over 7% per year for the next five years.
The specific project objectives are to improve the level of service and accommodate traffic growth along the A3 national and regional corridor linking the autonomous Port of Abidjan, a maritime entrance to Côte d'Ivoire, to the neighboring countries to the north without maritime facades, in particular Burkina Faso and Mali.
The key results expected from the traffic growth and improved level of service are:
a. Travel time between Bouaké and Kanawolo reduced for light vehicles: from 1.8 hours in 2022 to 1.2 hours in 2028; Travel time between Bouaké and Kanawolo reduced for heavy goods vehicles: from 2.1 hours in 2022 to 1.5 hours in 2028; b. VOC costs between Bouaké and Kanawolo for light vehicles: from 0.32 Euro/veh-km in 2022 to 0.26 Euro/veh-km in 2028. Reduction in VOC between Bouaké and Kanawolo for heavy goods vehicles: by 1.12 Euro/veh-km in 2022 for heavy goods vehicles at 0.9Euro/veh-km in 2028. c. Average Annual Daily Traffic (AADT): from 3441 veh/d in 2022 to 4811 veh/d in 2028. d. The construction of a 117 km 2x2 highway a 9 grade separation
